警視廳統計書 1935

Keishichō tōkeisho (Statistical Report of the Metropolitan Police Board), 第45回, 昭和10年 (1935)
警視總監官房文書課 (Secretariat, Superintendent-General of the Metropolitan Police), 東京, 1936

All 353 numbered statistical tables are transcribed; the contents, the chapter dividers and the coloured charts (圖表) are not. Each spread was read once by Claude Sonnet 5.5 from full-resolution crops, with no checking by eye. Columns next to the binding are sometimes clipped or faded, so some tables have runs of [?] in their innermost column; printed totals that do not add up are kept as printed and noted.
